QuestInfo.name: [Alliance Mission] Defense Mission - Cleansing Light
QuestInfo.0:
#e#bDefense Mission - Cleansing Light#k#n

#bMission Period#k
From 12/26/2018 until the Black Mage is defeated!

After the Black Mage ravaged Maple Word, the Alliance decided to eliminate his remaining forces using a powerful fiery cleansing energy.
Defeat monsters near your level to gain flame support.
You can get#b determination#k when the Cleansing Light descends, and you can acquire additional #bdetermination#k if a monster is defeated by the Cleansing Light.

#bThe Cleansing Light won't activate once you've collected 50,000 determination for the day.#k
#bThe Cleansing Light won't activate in some areas, including Tenebris.#k
